ecg-axis.l: Net QRS deflection in lead I
Net QRS deflection in lead aVF
Net QRS deflection in lead II (optional)

eckardt.l: Dysphagia (difficulty swallowing) [0 - none; 1 - occasional; 2 - daily; 3 - at every meal]
Regurgitation [0 - none; 1 - occasional; 2 - daily; 3 - at every meal]
Retrosternal chest pain [0 - none; 1 - occasional; 2 - daily; 3 - at every meal]
Weight loss [0 - none; 1 - less than 5 kg (about 11 lb); 2 - 5 to 10 kg (about 11 to 22 lb); 3 - more than 10 kg (about 22 lb)]

ecmo-titration.l: Target PaCO2 (defaults to 40 mmHg, which the reading names)
Hemoglobin (with the saturation, for DO2i and the flow suggestion)
SaO2 or post-oxygenator SatO2 (with the hemoglobin, for DO2i)

ecog-karnofsky.l: ECOG performance status (0 fully active ... 5 dead)

ecst-carotid.l: Distal internal carotid diameter beyond the bulb (mm)
Estimated original diameter at the stenosis (mm)
